notes.title: Ultima Chess VR - Release Date Changed!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]Ultima Chess VR is a unique experience. It is not only a chess project, but also a part of our Ultima Realm universe. Within it, a piece of its story will be told, which will continue in the upcoming games.[/p][p]Since this is an ambitious franchise, we need a bit more time to polish and improve the experience, as well as refine the mechanics, content, and more.[/p][p]Therefore, our team has decided to postpone the release date from September 2025 to 2026.[/p][p]We eagerly look forward to the moment when you can dive into the chess competitions and the world of Ultima Realm, and discover its story.[/p][p][b]Thank you for your support.[/b][/p][p][b]Sincerely,
The Ultima Realm Team.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Ultima Chess Devlog: 0.1 - 0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, today we will talk about what chess AI we will use, the Ancient environment, and chess movements mechanics.

[h2]Stockfish & The C++ Chess AI[/h2]
We will integrate Stockfish for the PC and SteamVR versions. For Meta, we will use the C++ Chess AI with 1500 Elo. So far, Stockfish has not been implemented on a Meta platform, and it is technically difficult to run Stockfish on Android, so we will use this AI for now.

[h2]Ancient Environment[/h2]
We completed blocking and art desing first of twelve location. Regard to its name, it's home location for Ancient faction. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/dabf6884831302a6259d970b3ab1b4c38ebba57b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/dabf6884831302a6259d970b3ab1b4c38ebba57b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/671d84ec309b32f5574484365841813e1f00a9c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/49827cb1e6684ca5f58f095a1b033b076c75c205.jpg[/img]

[h2]Chess Movements Mechanics[/h2]
We've also finalized the implementation of chess moves for the characters, so now they will make the appropriate moves, according to the chess pieces. We implemented the mechanics on Unreal Engine 5 via Blueprint. This is what it looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/c0c25cf58a7afd3e0b77ef9fe3ba7b6071806ae2.jpg[/img]

It's all for today, see you soon:)
